identity.title: Re-run EverRun dogfood and close the governance feedback loop

human_pressure.one_screen_brief: After the dogfood-discovered projection fix, governance coverage, and regression delta are implemented, re-run the same bounded EverRun evidence sample and verify that previously observed pipeline failures or false negatives converge without creating new false positives. Produce a final acceptance record that distinguishes fixed, still-open, expected-unknown, and newly-discovered gaps.
human_pressure.why_now: A governance feature is not validated by implementation alone; the same production evidence that exposed the gap must prove the repair.
do_not_misread: Do not replace the original baseline sample to make results look better.
Do not require every unknown to disappear; justified unknown is acceptable.
New gaps remain findings for future packs rather than scope expansion in this pack.
red_lines: No new governance feature implementation in this pack.
No changing expected judgments after seeing Ailuros output unless the evidence record itself was wrong and the correction is documented.

machine_core.goal: Re-run the original bounded EverRun dogfood baseline after packs 8048-8050 and produce an evidence-backed convergence/acceptance record for the governance pipeline.
red_lines: No baseline cherry-picking or sample replacement.
Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.
invariants: Use the same baseline sample identifiers from 8047 wherever those runs remain available.
Preserve original human expected judgments and evidence references unless a documented evidence correction is necessary.
Every previously recorded false negative or pipeline failure has an explicit post-fix status.
Newly discovered gaps are recorded, not fixed inside this pack.

producer.artifact: 8047 EverRun dogfood baseline plus fixes from 8048-8050

observable_effect.assertion: Replaying the same representative evidence shows whether previously identified governance gaps converge while preserving justified unknown and avoiding new false positives.

proofs.assertion: The acceptance record compares before/after classifications for the same baseline sample and all repository validation passes.

failure_semantics: A still-open false negative remains open and prevents claiming complete convergence for that finding.
A new false positive is recorded as a regression rather than ignored.
Expected unknown remains acceptable when evidence is genuinely insufficient.

steps.title: Re-run the baseline sample
details: Use the same representative run identifiers and expected judgments captured by 8047.
Execute the production load/ingest/rebuild/report path after 8048-8050 are complete.

steps.title: Compare before and after
details: For each prior false negative, false positive, expected unknown and pipeline failure, record the post-fix classification.
Use governance regression delta where applicable to explain semantic changes between before/after evidence outputs.

steps.title: Record convergence status
details: Mark findings fixed, still-open, expected-unknown, or newly-discovered.
Do not alter expected judgments merely to match implementation output.

steps.title: Close or seed next batch
details: Document whether the dogfood batch is accepted and list any new evidence-backed gaps as candidate future packs without implementing them here.

acceptance: The same bounded sample from 8047 is re-evaluated after 8048-8050.
Every original gap has an explicit before/after status.
Justified unknown remains visible and is not counted as clean success.
No new false positive is hidden.
Any remaining gaps are evidence-backed and explicitly deferred.

must_check: The same baseline sample is used unless unavailability is explicitly documented.
Before/after judgments and evidence are preserved audibly.
No production or test files are modified.
reject_if: The baseline sample is cherry-picked or replaced without evidence-based reason.
Expected judgments are silently rewritten to match implementation.
Production code or tests are changed.
Unknown is presented as clean success.

validation_notes.targeted_contract_coverage: This is a documentation/evidence convergence pack with no code changes; full suite confirms the accepted runtime state after prior implementation packs.
